build_diffusers_pipeline_from_pretrained: build a diffusers pipeline from a pretrained model path using the from_pretrained class method
run_diffusers_pipeline_forward: run the diffusers pipeline forward method on a request batch with server arguments
execute_diffusers_stage_forward: execute the diffusers execution stage forward method to run the wrapped diffusers pipeline on a batch
apply_vae_optimizations_to_pipeline: apply vae slicing and tiling optimizations to a diffusers pipeline for lower memory usage
apply_torch_compile_to_pipeline: apply torch.compile to transformer or unet components of a diffusers pipeline for accelerated inference
